assets.title: Pastel Playground Corner
assets.description: Original game-visual playground corner on a 6x4.6 m base, combining a pivoted seesaw and continuous curved slide. Beam_Runtime is independent with Blender pivot (-1.4,-0.4,0.73)m / glTF (-1.4,0.73,0.4)m and axis Blender +Y / glTF -Z; Base_Runtime contains fixed pieces. Seven discrete seesaw poses in -15 to +15 degrees are checked. No physics, animation clip, engineering or facility safety certification is included.

assets.title: Soft Low-poly Seesaw
assets.description: Original game-visual seesaw with a 2.6 m beam, two seats and grips. Beam_Runtime is separate from Base_Runtime, with pivot Blender (0,0,0.64)m / glTF (0,0.64,0)m and axis Blender +Y / glTF -Z. Intended visual angle range is -15 to +15 degrees; seven discrete poses are checked. Source has separately editable pieces and SeesawPivot_Edit marker. No animation clip, physics or playground engineering specification is included.

assets.title: Curved Low-poly Slide
assets.description: Original game-visual small slide. Entry platform is 1.35 m high; the continuous closed faceted chute descends along +Y with matching inset curved rims. Four platform feet, ladder feet and toe support are separately editable. Ladder rungs attach to both rails. Intended as a visual module, not a safety-rated physical facility or engineering design.
